```{r}
library(mlbench)
library(ggplot2)
data(BostonHousing2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(BostonHousing2, aes(x = medv, y = chas)) +
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(x = "Median Value of Owner-Occupied Homes ($1000s)",
       y = "Charles River Dummy Variable",
       title = "Median Value of Owner-Occupied Homes Along vs. Not Along Charles River in Boston Census Tracts, 1970") +
  theme_classic()
```
